interpretation: index set of the test set (prints I with a test subscript)

interpretation: outcome value of a held-out observation (fixed), y with subscript star and the index of the observation

interpretation: number of true negatives in a confusion matrix, n_{T-}

interpretation: conditional probability density function f(A | B), \condpdf{A}{B}

interpretation: conditional cumulative distribution function F(A | B), \condcdf{A}{B}

interpretation: generalization error operator Err (expected loss of a prediction rule on new data)

interpretation: fitted value at input x from a fit leaving out fold j, ŷ^(-j)(x); \fittedwo{j}{x}

interpretation: leverage h_i of observation i (diagonal of the hat matrix)

interpretation: mean squared error MSE_j on fold j

interpretation: mean squared error of fitting procedure g on fold j, MSE^g_j; \foldmseof{j}{g}

interpretation: standard error SE_CV(k) of the cross-validation estimate

interpretation: estimated prediction function applied to the argument
